long_biography.plain_text:
Abu Al-Rub spent four decades in Saudi road contracting, initially as an executive manager and co-founder of a major Eastern Province contractor. His work encompassed transport links, municipal streets and private site development, with projects delivered for national ministries, regional authorities, utilities and large industrial clients.

In 2010, he founded Basel Abu Al-Rub & Partner Company in Al Khobar and remained its active chief executive. The firm focuses on roads, highways and civil infrastructure, supported by concrete and construction-material operations in Dammam. His career is defined by hands-on leadership of government and private-sector contracting rather than passive investment, combining long experience with control of an owner-named operating company.
